|lore=Docking bay security officer. Leader. Honored for bravery aboard the Star Destroyer Thunderflare where he rescued five officers from the wreckage of a shuttle crash.
|game_text=While aboard Thunderflare, attrition against you is -2 here. Once during your turn, if at a battleground, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. If it is a character, may reveal it and opponent loses 1 Force (if it is a Rebel, may also place it on Used Pile).
|errata_history=This is the original printing: the PC card image current at the set's official release, first published 27 September 2019. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Captain Khurgee (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), a re-rendered image with the same words. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 27 September 2019<ref name="ht-kg-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f2c3fe/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Dark/large/captainkhurgee.gif captainkhurgee.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0f2c3fe 0f2c3fe] (27 September 2019).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “While aboard Thunderflare, attrition against you is -2 here. Once during your turn, if at a battleground, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. If it is a character, may reveal it and opponent loses 1 Force (if it is a Rebel, may also place it on Used Pile).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Khurgee (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-kg-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Dark/large/captainkhurgee.gif captainkhurgee.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); a small “71” is added beside the Premium icon. Same words; a re-rendered image, so it is its own version, not an errata of the text. Text: “While aboard Thunderflare, attrition against you is -2 here. Once during your turn, if at a battleground, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck. If it is a character, may reveal it and opponent loses 1 Force (if it is a Rebel, may also place it on Used Pile).”
*: The lower part of this re-rendered card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was published first, as a partial slip under the label “•Captain Khurgee” on the Players Committee's Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)<ref name="sheetP-20221212">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF, 2 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, Updated December 2022”; file created 12 December 2022). Released with [[Virtual Set P]] (24 February 2017 and 30 August 2019); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 12 December 2022, before the full card image was uploaded on 3 January 2023. Same words ([[:File:VP-D-captainkhurgee-2022-12-12-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on [[Captain Khurgee (V) (Errata)]].
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
